{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tapered wool-blend coat in navy blue (#000080), knee-length hem, relaxed fit, heavy-weight woven fabric for rain protection.
Crew-neck merino wool tunic in charcoal gray (#36454F), hip-length cut with a subtle ribbed texture, soft knit fabric.
Wide-leg crepe trousers in stone beige (#D2B48C), ankle-length hem to keep the silhouette streamlined while walking, fluid woven fabric.
Chelsea boots in suede taupe (#9CAE8D), ankle height with an elastic side panel for easy wear, water-resistant finish, sturdy sole.

This outfit prioritizes functionality and comfort for a full day of walking through rainy autumn weather, fulfilling the specific wish for suede ankle boots while providing necessary coverage with a trench-style coat. The neutral color palette of charcoal, stone, and navy creates a polished yet relaxed look that fits a creative office environment without requiring formal attire. Every piece is chosen to manage moisture and allow ease of movement, ensuring she looks put-together and feels confident from morning commute until late afternoon meetings."}
